actual_coverage.excluded: EU gas storage, LNG, electricity, measured Weather and measured GEV

claims.text: No configured petroleum series crossed the registered absolute robust-z threshold of 3.5.
Gasoline and distillate inventories were below year-ago levels but both built during the latest measured week.
The measured evidence does not support a broad new U.S. petroleum scarcity anomaly.
The requested 14–20 September event week remains unobserved because the latest source week ended 11 September.

limitations: The requested event week had no configured period endpoints.
The history is current-vintage and does not prove first-release values.
The private artifact ZIP returned HTTP 403; exact SQLite bytes were verified via authorized private Git but the full raw fileset was not rehashed.
Gas, LNG, electricity and matched Weather/GEV controls were untested.
Product supplied is a flow proxy, not measured end-user consumption.
Shared EIA ancestry with suite Energy is not independent corroboration.
